mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals strong supply-side momentum that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also accelerating, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are declining and retail sales (RSAFS) are also weakening, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both declining, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing faster than its 12-month moving average, it signals a strengthening labor market that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 12mo MA, but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is also above its 12-month moving average, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 12mo MA, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is contracting year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is also rising, it signals a recessionary environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY < 0 and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
